description: The 2026 conforming (FHFA, Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) and FHA (HUD) loan limits for 1–4 unit homes in a county CapCenter serves, with the official sources. A loan above the conforming limit is a Jumbo loan. Answers in Spanish with language=es (límites de préstamo).

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county or richmond.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

name: get_loan_limits
title: Get 2026 county loan limits
